evidence.title: MRMAD: A Multi-Round Multi-Audio Benchmark for Evaluating Acoustic Degradation Perception in Large Audio-Language Models

summary: Researchers introduce MRMAD, a multi-round, multi-audio benchmark designed to assess how well large audio-language models perceive and handle acoustic degradation. The tool aims to improve robustness in real-world audio applications.
title: New Benchmark MRMAD Evaluates Acoustic Degradation Perception in Large Audio-Language Models
